topics.label: The Sun
facts: The Sun is a star, and it gives Earth light and heat.
The Sun rises in the morning and sets in the evening.
You should never look straight at the Sun because it can hurt your eyes.

questions.fact: The Sun is a star, the closest star to Earth.

questions.fact: The Sun's light and heat warm our planet.

questions.fact: A hat and sunscreen protect your skin from strong sunlight.

topics.label: Pets
facts: Pets are animals that live with people at home.
Dogs and cats are two of the most popular pets.
Pets need food, water, a clean home, and love every day.
Some people keep fish, birds, rabbits, or hamsters as pets.

choices: A wild animal in the jungle
An animal that lives with people at home
questions.fact: Pets are animals that live with people and are cared for at home.

questions.q: What do pets need every day?
questions.fact: Pets need food, water, and care every single day.

questions.q: Which of these is a popular pet?
questions.fact: Cats are one of the most popular pets in the world.
Goldfish live in a tank or bowl full of clean water.

topics.label: Seasons
facts: There are four seasons: spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
Summer is usually the warmest season.
Winter is usually the coldest season, and it can snow.
In autumn, many leaves change colour and fall from the trees.

questions.fact: The four seasons are spring, summer, autumn, and winter.

questions.q: Which season is usually the warmest?
questions.fact: Summer is usually the warmest season of the year.

questions.q: In which season do many leaves fall from trees?
questions.fact: In autumn, leaves turn orange, red, and yellow, then fall.

questions.q: What can fall from the sky in winter?
questions.fact: Snow falls in winter when the air is very cold.

topics.label: Clouds
facts: Clouds are made of tiny drops of water or tiny bits of ice floating high in the sky.
Puffy white clouds are called cumulus clouds, and they often appear on sunny days.
Dark grey clouds are usually full of water and can bring rain.
Clouds form when warm, wet air rises and cools down high in the sky.

choices: Tiny drops of water or bits of ice
questions.fact: Clouds are made of tiny water droplets or ice crystals floating in the air.

questions.q: Which clouds are puffy and white?
questions.fact: Cumulus clouds are the puffy white ones you often see on sunny days.

questions.q: Which clouds are most likely to bring rain?
questions.fact: Dark grey clouds are heavy with water and often bring rain.

choices: Wind blows them from the sea only

questions.fact: When warm, wet air rises and cools, the water in it forms tiny droplets: a cloud.
